title: Score Decrements When Earning Points Above 500 Threshold
explanation: At frame 424, PlayerData.set_score dropped score from 500 to 490 (-10) after collecting Coin8, triggering an unexpected_score_change anomaly. Repeated across frames 834, 880, 1003, 1124, 1206, and 1706. Violates monotonicity and design contract that score only increases from play.

title: Phantom Enemy Wall Reversal Freezes Patrol at Zero Velocity
explanation: At frame 690, Enemy4 triggered enemy_reversed_at_wall with old_direction: 0.0 and new_direction: 0.0 at position (5059.96, 800.0) following rapid wall reversals (frames 561-673). In Enemy.gd, multiplying velocity.x (0.0) by -1.0 permanently stops patrol velocity, violating AI autonomy contracts.

title: Seventh Coin Collection Suppresses Score Award
explanation: At frame 934, Coin11 was picked (total_coins_collected == 7) but PlayerData.score remained 570 despite coin_score_awarded logging a score gain of 100. In Coin.gd:L58-L59, should_award_score is explicitly disabled for the 7th coin, violating collectible reward contracts.

title: Player Out of Bounds Void Fall Without Death
explanation: At frame 1820, player exceeded the level threshold (OUT_OF_BOUNDS_Y = 1400.0) reaching Y=1412.4, triggering player_out_of_bounds anomaly. In Player.gd:L214-L222, the anomaly is logged but die() is never called, causing the player to fall continuously past Y=290,889 without death or respawn.
